def equation(x: np.ndarray, v: np.ndarray, params: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator

    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized

    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    """ Mathematical function for acceleration in a damped nonlinear oscillator
    
    Args:
        x: A numpy array representing observations of current position.
        v: A numpy array representing observations of velocity.
        params: Array of numeric constants or parameters to be optimized
    
    Return:
        A numpy array representing acceleration as the result of applying the mathematical function to the inputs.
    """
    n = params[0]    # Nonlinearity factor
    kp = params[1]   # Linear damping coefficient
    cv = params[2]   # Velocity cubed damping coefficient
    kx = params[3]   # Linear stiffness coefficient
    xd = params[4]   # Damping constant
    st = params[5]   # Harmonic driving frequency
    dt = params[6]   # Time increment
    t = params[7]    # Time up to current iteration
    ta = params[8]   # Time at the next iteration
    f = params[9]    # Fractional order of the fractional calculus
    w = params[10]   # Damping in power law (if fractional damping is considered)
    P = params[11]   # Power factor for fractional damping (if fractional damping is considered)
    δ = params[12]   # Inertia, if fractional damping is considered
    
    # Position update
    tnew = t + dt
    ta = tnew if tnew < ta else t
